ISSUE 02 / OCTOBER 2026
RUNWAY

STUDY 098
Cream Half-Zip & Black Wide Trousers
Rights check
Source: 24991.jpg
Refined, classic, polished
WORKING NOTES
- The cream sweater and blue cuffs create the color
layering.
- Keep the tan backdrop for a warm studio tone.
Try this: Keep the tan backdrop for a warm studio tone.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
loose brown waves stands full-length
against a warm tan backdrop. She
wears a cream ribbed half-zip sweater
with a blue collared shirt peeking out at
the cuffs and neck, a pearl necklace,
and black wide-leg trousers. She holds
brown leather gloves and a black tote.
Her expression is calm. Soft, even
studio light. Palette of cream, cornflower
blue, and black. Refined and classic, in
the style of a fall lookbook.
